sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Setup is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Alright, mater. Heard what the Scav are arguing about lately? Proper war going on between them. Wouldn't be a problem, except my lads keep getting caught in the middle of it. They ain't exactly helpless, but a bit of backup wouldn't hurt. Here's what I came up with: those idiots have their own dress code. The big shots walk around showing off in ushankas, Scav vests, and those bloody JayPC carriers. What a bunch of clowns, eh? You dress up like one of them, grab their weapons, and start dropping PMCs left and right. Doesn't matter who exactly, just make sure they end up blaming those idiots. You get what I'm saying, yeah?"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 8 PMC operatives with Scav weapons while wearing the specified gear on Customs

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Skier Rep +0.25
- 1,000 Euros
  - 1,050 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 1,150 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 3× Xenomorph sealing foam
"My guys are saying that Customs is at World War 3 right now, BEARs and USECs are dropping Scavs left and right! Good shit, nice work. Here's your prize, as promised."

In this quest you have to kill 8 PMCs with any of the following guns while wearing one of the above hats and chest rigs:
- ADAR 2-15 5.56x45 carbine
- MP-133 12ga pump-action shotgun
- MP-153 12ga semi-automatic shotgun
- MP-155 12ga semi-automatic shotgun
- MP-18 7.62x54R single-shot rifle
- MP-43 12ga sawed-off double-barrel shotgun
- MP-43-1C 12ga double-barrel shotgun
- Molot Arms Simonov OP-SKS 7.62x39 carbine
